_about: The touch controls (web/touch.js). A thumb on the left of the screen (`stick_side` of its width) is a stick: dragged past `dead_zone` of `stick_radius` CSS pixels toward a side, it holds that direction's action. A drag on the right half looks around, `look_scale` mouse pixels for each finger pixel. `buttons` are always there while you play, on foot or in the car as `when` says; `abilities` maps each of the car's abilities, as the core lists them, to the action its button holds.
